description: Extract exact, contiguous contract text spans for the 31 CUAD review-clause categories. Return only text copied from the document, keep distinct occurrences separate, and do not paraphrase, summarize, stitch spans, or infer absent categories.

ClauseSpans.description: Extract every distinct clause occurrence matching the category definitions below. Each array item must be one exact, contiguous, character-for-character document span. Return an empty array when a category is absent.

MostFavoredNation.description: Exact spans providing that if a third party receives better terms for relevant technology, goods, or services, a party is entitled to those better terms. Return each distinct occurrence separately.

items.description: One exact contiguous Most Favored Nation clause span.

NonCompete.description: Exact spans restricting a party from competing with the counterparty or operating in a geography, business, or technology sector, during or after the contract.

items.description: One exact contiguous Non-Compete clause span.

Exclusivity.description: Exact spans imposing exclusive dealing, requirements purchasing, or prohibitions on licensing, selling, collaborating, or working with third parties.

items.description: One exact contiguous Exclusivity clause span.

NoSolicitOfCustomers.description: Exact spans restricting a party from contracting with or soliciting customers or partners of the counterparty.

items.description: One exact contiguous No-Solicit of Customers clause span.

CompetitiveRestrictionException.description: Exact spans stating exceptions or carve-outs to Non-Compete, Exclusivity, or No-Solicit of Customers restrictions.

items.description: One exact contiguous Competitive Restriction Exception span.

NoSolicitOfEmployees.description: Exact spans restricting solicitation or hiring of the counterparty's employees or contractors.

items.description: One exact contiguous No-Solicit of Employees clause span.

NonDisparagement.description: Exact spans requiring a party not to disparage the counterparty.

items.description: One exact contiguous Non-Disparagement clause span.

TerminationForConvenience.description: Exact spans allowing termination without cause, usually by notice and expiration of a waiting period.

items.description: One exact contiguous Termination for Convenience clause span.

RofrRofoRofn.description: Exact spans granting a right of first refusal, first offer, or first negotiation concerning equity, technology, assets, products, or services.

items.description: One exact contiguous ROFR, ROFO, or ROFN clause span.

AntiAssignment.description: Exact spans restricting assignment or requiring consent or notice before assignment to a third party.

items.description: One exact contiguous Anti-Assignment clause span.
